span.p:
1. Alert: signature rule, or anomaly trigger rule
on a webhook ad_alert line

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. radar_ar.py maps the alert to an ar.yaml scenario
(rule ID, then rule group)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Anomaly alert from the
webhook agent's log?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Collect context events from the indexer
(delta_signature_minutes or delta_ad_minutes),
extract IOCs

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. Risk score from anomaly, signature and CTI terms,
fused where enabled; tier 0 to 3

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. Flowintel case via DECIPHER incident endpoint
(when reachable) and email notification

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier mitigations: firewall-drop, lock_user_linux.sh,
terminate_service.sh, sent via Wazuh API
to the endpoint's agent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

6. Record every step and decision
in /var/ossec/logs/active-responses.log
